summary: READ-ONLY Firebase integration verification for TyreBook. Logged in as owner@test.com / password, created a tyre (MRF/Test/185/65 R15/Buy 1000/Sell 1500/Stock 1/Rack A1) via /inventory/car -> /inventory/tyre-form?category=car. Collected localStorage keys, IndexedDB databases, network requests, and console messages. CONCLUSION: AsyncStorage fallback active — Firebase is NOT active. No fixes applied.

integration_issues.issue: Firebase is not active at runtime. Data is being persisted to the browser's localStorage under the key `tyrebook.tyres` (AsyncStorage fallback on web). Auth is also local — `tyrebook.localUser` stores {uid:'local-owner-...', role:'owner'}. All 6 EXPO_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* env vars are empty, so isFirebaseConfigured() returns false and getDb() returns null; every data module takes the AsyncStorage branch.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Appears on both /login and /inventory/tyre-form. Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: any component still passing pointerEvents as a prop.

Q1_localStorage_tyrebook_tyres.evidence: localStorage key 'tyrebook.tyres' present. Value contains the newly-created row: [{"categoryId":"car","tyreClass":"new","brand":"MRF","model":"Test","size":"185/65 R15","purchasePrice":1000,"sellingPrice":1500,"currentStock":1,"rackNumber":"A1","id":"local-1785583579340-15sw","createdAt":1785583579324,...}]. All localStorage keys after save: ['tyrebook.localUser','tyrebook.tyres'].

Q2_indexeddb_firestore.evidence: indexedDB.databases() returned an empty array []. No 'firestore/*', 'firebaseLocalStorageDb', or any Firebase-related IndexedDB database exists.

Q3_firebase_network_requests.evidence: Zero requests observed to firebase*, firestore.googleapis.com, googleapis.com/identitytoolkit, or firebaseio.com during login, form open, and save (monitored via page.on('request')).

Q4_firebase_console_messages.evidence: Zero console messages containing 'firebase', 'Firestore', or 'auth/'. Only 6 console messages total across the full flow: React DevTools info (x2), Expo `Running application` logs (x2), and a `props.pointerEvents is deprecated` warning (x2).

verification_qna.conclusion: AsyncStorage fallback active. Firebase is NOT active.

additional_evidence.post_login_localstorage: tyrebook.localUser = {"uid":"local-owner-1785583568885","email":"owner@test.com","displayName":"owner","role":"owner"}  (uid prefix 'local-' confirms local auth fallback, not Firebase Auth)
additional_evidence.tyre_id_format: local-1785583579340-15sw (client-generated 'local-' prefix — not a Firestore document ID)
additional_evidence.ui_confirms_row: After save, /inventory/car shows '1 SKUs' with the 'MRF · Test' row visible.

action_items: Firebase integration is confirmed INACTIVE at runtime. Data (tyres, users) is stored in browser localStorage via the AsyncStorage fallback. To activate Firebase, populate the 6 EXPO_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* variables in /app/frontend/.env with a valid Firebase Web App config and restart Expo (supervisorctl restart expo). No google-services.json is present (not required for the web build; only for native builds).
Optional cleanup: migrate any remaining `pointerEvents={...}` props to `style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}` to silence the deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: src/firebase/config.ts isFirebaseConfigured() correctly guards on apiKey && projectId && appId; with empty env vars the guard returns false and getDb() returns null — this is why every data module (inventory/sales/khata/master/purchase/stock/users/vehicles) falls through to AsyncStorage. Behaviour is as designed given the current env configuration.
seed_data_creation: Created one tyre via UI as required by the task (MRF/Test/185/65 R15, Buy 1000, Sell 1500, Stock 1, Rack A1). Persisted only in browser localStorage under `tyrebook.tyres`.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TyreBook auth login button text is 'Sign in' (not 'Login'). Add-tyre FAB testID is `category-add-tyre`. Tyre form field testIDs: tyre-brand, tyre-model, tyre-pattern, tyre-size, tyre-compat, tyre-ply, tyre-load-index, tyre-speed-rating, tyre-purchase-price, tyre-mrp, tyre-company-price, tyre-selling-price, tyre-min-alert, tyre-stock, tyre-rack. Submit button text is 'Save Tyre'. When EXPO_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* env vars are empty, the app persists to browser localStorage under `tyrebook.*` keys (localUser, tyres, etc.).
rca_of_issue: Firebase is inactive because the 6 EXPO_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* variables in /app/frontend/.env are empty strings. src/firebase/config.ts::isFirebaseConfigured() requires apiKey && projectId && appId — all three are falsy — so initializeApp() is skipped, getDb() returns null, and every data module branches into the AsyncStorage fallback. On the web build AsyncStorage maps to window.localStorage, which is why keys such as `tyrebook.tyres` and `tyrebook.localUser` appear in Application → Local Storage. Fix: populate the Firebase Web App config values in frontend/.env and restart Expo.
